description: Scaffold the complete Electron + React + Vite + TypeScript + TailwindCSS project with the full modular directory structure. Set up build tooling, dev scripts, and core configuration files.
steps: Initialize pnpm project with package.json including all dependencies: electron, react, react-dom, three, @types/three, typescript, vite, @vitejs/plugin-react, tailwindcss, postcss, autoprefixer, electron-builder, vitest, @testing-library/react, concurrently, electron-vite or vite-plugin-electron
Create vite.config.ts for the renderer process with React plugin and path aliases
Create electron main process entry at src/main/main.ts that creates a BrowserWindow loading the Vite dev server or built output
Create src/main/preload.ts with contextBridge exposing IPC APIs for audio device access
Create src/renderer/index.html as the Electron renderer HTML entry
Create src/renderer/main.tsx as the React entry point
Create src/renderer/App.tsx as the root React component with basic layout shell
Set up TailwindCSS with tailwind.config.ts and src/renderer/styles/globals.css with cyberpunk/dark theme colors
Create tsconfig.json with strict mode, path aliases (@core, @audio, @render, @shaders, @scenes, @effects, @ui, @utils, @config, @presets, @particles, @camera, @plugins, @community)

Create the full directory structure: src/core/, src/audio-engine/, src/render-engine/, src/shaders/, src/shaders/post-processing/, src/shaders/vertex/, src/shaders/fragment/, src/scenes/, src/effects/, src/particles/, src/camera/, src/presets/, src/plugins/, src/community/, src/ui/, src/ui/components/, src/ui/panels/, src/ui/layouts/, src/utils/, src/config/, src/assets/
Create src/core/Engine.ts stub - the main orchestrator class that will initialize audio, render, and scene systems
Create src/config/defaults.ts with default configuration constants (resolution, FPS target, audio FFT size, etc.)
Create src/utils/math.ts with common math utilities (lerp, clamp, map, smoothstep)
Create package.json scripts: dev (concurrent Vite + Electron), build (Vite build + electron-builder), test (vitest), typecheck (tsc --noEmit), lint
Create README.md with project overview, tech stack, installation guide, development guide, build instructions
acceptance_criteria: pnpm build compiles TypeScript and bundles the renderer without errors
pnpm typecheck passes with no type errors
pnpm test runs (even if no tests yet, the runner initializes)
Directory structure exists with all required folders
README.md documents installation, development, and build
findings: All verification steps pass. Used type:module in package.json with ESM-compatible electron config. The electron main process uses import.meta.url for __dirname equivalent. Vitest runs in jsdom environment. The tsc command in build operates on the renderer tsconfig (noEmit) first, then vite builds the renderer, then tsc compiles the electron main process with tsconfig.electron.json. Use pnpm test --run for single-run tests.
